about: I am a dedicated Lead Software Engineer passionate about crafting scalable distributed systems and high-performance APIs, with a strong focus on frontend architecture and full-stack development. My expertise lies in modernizing enterprise platforms using cutting-edge technologies like React.js, TypeScript, and Micro Frontends, complemented by robust backend skills in Node.js, GraphQL, and AWS. I thrive on leading large-scale transformations, optimizing performance, and fostering innovation through AI-assisted engineering practices. I enjoy solving complex challenges that enhance user experience, streamline operations, and drive significant improvements in product maintainability and release velocity.

description: Led UI modernization across IBM ISC and ISIM, migrating from Dojo to React.js/TypeScript with Carbon Design System, eliminating legacy bottlenecks and reducing front-end technical debt by over 40%.
Spearheaded enterprise-wide Microfrontend architecture adoption across key IAM modules, improving team ownership, modular scalability, and accelerating release cycles by ~30%.
Standardized front-end engineering practices and scalable UI patterns, significantly enhancing maintainability, reducing duplication, and boosting developer productivity.
Drove AI-assisted engineering transformation by integrating tools like IBM Bob, improving test coverage and reducing manual unit testing effort by 30-40%.
Delivered critical features for IBM Security Verify Governance (ISVG), including Manage Certification and Authorization modules, enhancing enterprise IAM workflow efficiency.
Developed and improved the ARC (Activity Risk Mitigation) module for real-time detection of SoD and Sensitive Access violations, strengthening compliance and reducing security risks.
Modernized legacy Dojo.js-based access workflows by introducing time-bound access controls and native file upload, significantly improving user experience and reducing support overhead.
Designed and implemented a dynamic Custom Roles framework using TanStack Form with i18n and RTL support, reducing configuration effort by ~35% and enabling global adoption.
Developed and integrated robust REST APIs using TypeScript in a Node.js environment, ensuring seamless integration with front-end systems and databases while enhancing scalability.
Led the migration and modernization of legacy Java APIs to TypeScript, optimizing performance and reducing technical debt through detailed analysis and re-engineering.
Designed and implemented new backend capabilities, including AWS DynamoDB audit logging and event tracking with AWS Lambda, improving system observability and real-time monitoring.
Enhanced critical features like Rehire scenarios and GPN collision handling, performing RCA with AWS CloudWatch and Lambda to resolve production incidents and improve system stability.
